title: Panshi cross-context receipt envelope v1
description: Generic, non-self-referential envelope shared by every cross-context receipt (system-design.md §5.3). TBody is a compile-time generic in TypeScript (CrossContextReceiptEnvelopeV1<TBody>); JSON Schema has no generics, so `body` is left unconstrained here (an empty subschema, i.e. accept-anything) and a concrete consumer narrows it to exactly one of the three body schemas in this directory by switching on the `bodySchema` value: `panshi.receipts.command-admission-receipt-body/v1` -> command-admission-receipt-body.schema.json, `panshi.receipts.introduction-ready-receipt-body/v1` -> introduction-ready-receipt-body.schema.json, `panshi.receipts.scene-seed-validated-receipt-body/v1` -> scene-seed-validated-receipt-body.schema.json. See README.md for the full digest/signature computation order.

bodySchema.description: Identifies which of the three body schemas `body` must validate against. Concrete consumers use this value to pick the right schema to narrow `body` with; it is also the exact `bodySchema` byte string folded into the bodyDigest computation (see README.md step 1-2).

body.description: The TBody payload. Deterministic, map-free, float-free per system-design.md §5.3. Never contains its own envelope's bodyDigest, signature, append position, event ID/hash, or any other provenance field -- those live outside the envelope and are correlated only by bodyDigest. This schema intentionally applies no constraints here (accept any JSON value); validate `body` against the schema named by `bodySchema` for the real shape.

bodyDigest.description: sha256:<64 lowercase hex> of `HASH("panshi.cross-context-receipt/v1" || bodySchema || body_bytes)`, where body_bytes = deterministic_encode(bodySchema, body) using RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS) over the JSON form of `body`, exactly like the convention already established in contracts/sealed-facts/v1. This repository pins the abstract `HASH` in system-design.md §5.3 to SHA-256 for every receipt body in this contract family. bodyDigest is never itself folded into body_bytes -- see README.md for the full worked example.

signingKeyId.description: Opaque identifier (and implicit version) of the signing key used to produce `signature`. Never a credential or secret value itself.

signature.description: SIGN(signingKeyId, envelopeVersion || bodySchema || bodyDigest) per system-design.md §5.3. Opaque signature encoding (this contract does not pin an algorithm); real signing keys are not wired yet in this repository, so fixtures may carry a clearly-synthetic placeholder value here.
